# HK DevLab

> HK DevLab is a digital development studio in Attock, Pakistan, building websites, web apps, AI assistants and custom software for startups and small businesses.

Contact: contact@hkdevlab.com | WhatsApp: +92 324 0968723
Process: Discover, Design, Build, Launch, Grow
Free: 15-minute project call, website check

## Services
- [Website Development](https://www.hkdevlab.com/services/website-development): mobile-first business websites
- [Web App Development](https://www.hkdevlab.com/services/web-app-development): dashboards, portals, booking systems, MVPs
- [AI Assistants & Automation](https://www.hkdevlab.com/services/ai-assistants): customer chat assistants in English and Roman Urdu
- [Custom Software](https://www.hkdevlab.com/services/custom-software): internal tools and integrations
